name: Offers the alternatives when the slot is full
simulation_scenario: You are Nadia Ahmed, phone 07700 900123, calling to book a table for four on Friday at 8 pm. If the restaurant offers other times, accept the earliest one and confirm when asked. Answer questions briefly, one at a time.
success_conditions: The agent told the caller that 8 pm on Friday is not available and offered the alternative times that the availability tool returned (7:30 pm, 8:45 pm or 9 pm).
The agent did not say that 8 pm on Friday was available and did not book it.
